Busy live kitchen, you can witness how they do their craft and their passion for barbecuing. Love the Sunset views and beautiful ocean and not to mention the romantic dinner set up. A must for couples if you're looking for a romantic and extraordinary dining experience. Super thanks to one of the Staff, Nhi! She absolutely did her best to serve us better. She speaks english well and if you feel like no one is attending you, and that no one can understand you, Look For Nhi! I promise she won't disappoint you!

Don't waste your money or precious time in Phu Quoc!! (at least not until others prove here improvements have been made)
Sep 2018 • Family
We ate here for dinner and regretted it from the start. The ambiance is worse than boring, it is antiseptic and without any real character. There is horrible overhead can lighting and just generally a uninspired in every way.

The food was a mishmash of flavors that were either overly salty, loaded with thick tempura batter, or too oily and lacking any distinctive flavor. Add to this outrageous pricing and you have a night you will not forget for the wrong reasons.

The restaurant has just opened so they will surely improve over time, however the owners should (1) make the necessary investments and trainings now, (2) give all who dare to come a significant discount or incentive to help them improve (which we did not receive).
